about.title: About
about.heroTitle: A sewing office in Shaoxing and Guangzhou.
about.heroDescription: Knit jersey and fleece, woven shirts, outerwear and uniforms. We take a style from the first sample to packed cartons.
about.workflowDescription: Construction and monthly volume decide the factory. Fit and PP decide when cutting starts.
about.closingDescription: Send a tech pack or a reference garment. We reply with a factory and an MOQ.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heroDescription: Fit samples, size runs or a bulk PO — write to the person who will follow the style.

collections.title: Styles
collections.heroDescription: Knit tops, woven shirts, outerwear, activewear, uniforms and private label.
collections.benefitsTitle: What you get on a quote
collections.benefitsDescription: Factory, MOQ, sampling date, and a size range.
collections.stylesDescription: Retail floors, staff uniforms, gyms and brand drops.

brands.title: For brands
brands.description: Keep the block. Change the colour.
brands.content: Seasonal drops sew from a locked base size. We keep the factory assignment so a repeat order does not start from a new pattern.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.content: Private-label tops and uniforms. Size runs, hangtags and carton marks are written before cutting, so receiving does not relabel the floor.

agents.title: For agents
agents.description: Dated capacity and a measurement sheet.
agents.content: We book a sewing slot you can show a principal, and we issue measurement records by colour and size.

size-specs.title: Size specifications
size-specs.content: Send a chart or a fit sample. We grade XS–4XL for the market you sell into, and we do not cut bulk until the base is signed.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.content: A reference garment or a tech pack is enough to start. Fit comments go on the sample. PP locks the marker.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: BSCI, OEKO-TEX, and the audit you name.
certifications.content: We place the style in a factory that already holds the audit. Certificates travel with the order, not as a later email.

quality-control.title: Quality control
quality-control.content: Final audit covers measurements, stitch, appearance and carton count. The report is signed before the truck leaves.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.content: Send the style → pick the line → sign fit → sew the PO → count cartons. The merchandiser does not change in the middle.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content: Fit-sample cycles, MOQ by construction, deposit terms and AQL level — written before you open a bulk PO.

blog.title: Blog
blog.content: Grading, factory capability and how we pack a carton.
